_contract: WHICH state-eval implementation measured WHAT, and what may therefore be compared with what. Recorded PROSPECTIVELY, before any further measurement exists. It authorizes nothing, funds nothing, and changes no frozen record; it states a boundary that a frozen record already enforces.

baseline_completion._why_they_remain_valid: both sides of that completed comparison were measured by the HISTORICAL evaluator implementation: Search-1's frozen C candidates in attempt 4 and the rebuilt B in attempt 8. One implementation, one measurement series. Nothing about the optimization reaches backwards into it.

contract._not_amended: review declined to make the two evaluator hashes interchangeable. The contract is doing the correct thing by refusing, and an amendment would have traded a real guard for a green test suite.

moved.cause: the device-resident state-eval reduction, adopted by the 2026-09-18 performance round: `_reference_for` and the candidate forward stopped calling `.float().cpu()`, and the targets and tag masks follow the logits' device.
moved.measured_difference: certified on the COMPLETE frozen suite by logs/stages/stage-1/phase_c2/validations/state-eval-certification/v1/, against a predeclared absolute target on the ranked objectives. The figure a reader should use is that certification's, not the four-item benchmark's.
moved.second_cause: MOVED A SECOND TIME by the 2026-10-03 target-aware round: `StateEvaluator` takes a hash-bound scoring-position policy and an ExecutionConfig. The policy weights every state metric and is stamped into the evaluation's detail; the execution config lets the two FORWARDS batch while the reduction stays the same per-item `distortion` call at the same per-item shape with the same chunk boundaries. The evaluator's DEFAULT is the one-item-per-forward reference path and the default policy is `positions.all_v1`, which the reducers detect and treat as a no-op, so a caller that asks for neither performs the operations this file performed before the round. `batch_plan` and `_ensure_groups` are new and refuse over a derived memory budget rather than discovering an OOM mid-search.
moved._why_the_prefix_moved: it pins the CURRENT digest, so it goes stale on every edit to this file. That is the mechanism: the staleness forces a reader rather than letting a bound evaluator drift unread.
moved._boundary: This does NOT re-open the frozen baseline-completion series and does not change what the historical comparison measured. The protocol and its historical hash stay frozen exactly as they are, which is the point: a future B measurement taken under a target-aware policy is a measurement of a different quantity and must not join the old series. The round that moved this file could not avoid it — making the global state metric target-aware IS a change to this evaluator — so the obligation was to record it here, not to avoid it.
moved.third_cause: MOVED A THIRD TIME by the 2026-10-03 correction round: `StateEvaluator` computes a `measurement_protocol_id` and stamps it, with a `reduction` block, into every evaluation's detail; it also accepts an optional `NumericalEnvironment` and an optional `suite_content_sha256`. The last one is the point: `suite_hash` is the STRUCTURAL identity and this project pins it that way in 45 committed records, so the suite's CONTENT is bound in the new protocol id instead of being folded into the structural hash -- which would have moved the identity of an unchanged asset and reinterpreted every record that pinned it, including the frozen contract in this very file's protocol. Nothing in the arithmetic moved: the terms are read at construction, the stamp is metadata, and an evaluator given no policy, no numerics and no content hash performs exactly the operations it performed before, recording `undeclared` and `unbound` for what nobody stated.

optimized_evaluator.role: the CURRENT Phase-C2 Full Search implementation

_what_is_refused: appending a FUTURE B measurement, taken under the optimized evaluator, to the historical baseline-completion B<->C series. `bind_identities` in the baseline driver refuses at stage A, before a teacher is loaded.
_what_is_NOT_refused: the Phase-C2 Full Search. Its protocol does not bind the evaluator by hash, and it rescores all 578 leaves with ONE implementation, so it is internally consistent. Nothing about this boundary gates that search.
reopening_the_series_requires: a new explicit scientific decision. Not an amendment made in passing, not a test edit, and not an autonomous repair: re-measuring B under the optimized evaluator would create a second series, and whether the two may be compared is exactly the question this record refuses to answer by default.

moved_files.why: the operator package/batching round added an `execution: ExecutionConfig` parameter to `materialize_fixed_path`, its verified-suffix twin and their shared step loop, and threads it into `OperatorContext`. It is additive and defaulted: no operator ordering, applicability check, identity gate, artifact write or numeric path changes, and `micro_batch_size=1` reproduces the pre-round tree bit-for-bit on all six operators. It moves this file's sha256 and therefore appears here, which is the mechanism working: a bound evaluator file that drifts must be read, not absorbed.
moved_files._boundary: This does NOT re-open the frozen baseline-completion series. That comparison was measured end to end by the historical evaluator; nothing here reaches backwards into it, and the frozen contract still refuses a replay under a drifted evaluator -- which is exactly what it should do.
moved_files.second_cause: MOVED AGAIN by the 2026-10-03 target-aware round: the executor RESOLVES the step's declared scoring-position policy from the registry rather than accepting one, and the statistics-cache key gains the execution fingerprint and the policy hash. Additive and defaulted: a step declaring no policy resolves the incumbent, which is numerically inert.
moved_files.third_cause: MOVED AGAIN by the 2026-10-03 correction round: the step trace records a `scoring_content_report` -- the identity of the position metadata the resolved policy will read, plus the three totals a reader checks it against. Evidence only: it is written into the trace, not into any hashed config, and it is empty-equivalent at the incumbent policy, which reads no position metadata. No ordering, applicability check, identity gate, artifact write or numeric path changed.

_moved_files_note: `moved` is kept for readers bound to the single-mover shape; `moved_files` is the full list and is what the contract tests read. A file that drifts without an entry here still fails.
